Nest Pensions, officially known as the National Employment Savings Trust, is the UK's public-service defined contribution workplace pension scheme. Established under the Pensions Act 2008, it supports automatic enrolment for employees. Managed by Nest Corporation, a public body accountable to Parliament, the scheme operates on a not-for-profit basis, reinvesting profits to benefit its members. As of March 31, 2025, Nest manages approximately £49.7 billion in assets for around 13.8 million members across 1 million employers, making it the largest workplace pension in the UK.

Nest offers an automatic enrolment solution that helps employers fulfill their legal obligations to enroll eligible employees. Employees typically contribute 5% of their salary, with employers contributing 3% and the government providing 1% tax relief. The scheme also allows for pension consolidation and transfers, enabling members to manage their pensions online through personalized dashboards. Nest is committed to inclusion, value, and impact, ensuring that it serves all eligible employees, employers, and self-employed individuals fairly.

Founded in 2006, the company specializes in providing comprehensive tax compliance solutions for businesses of all sizes. TaxConnex focuses on managing the complexities of sales tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, offering services such as sales tax filings, notice management, audit defense, and nexus analysis.

The company has developed a proprietary platform called Connexion, which supports customized sales tax engagements. Recently, TaxConnex introduced taxC™, an AI-enhanced solution that automates tax calculations while ensuring human oversight. This product integrates advanced technology with managed filing and remittance services for effective sales, use, and telecom tax management. TaxConnex serves a diverse range of industries, including technology, e-commerce, and manufacturing, positioning itself as a partner that combines human expertise with innovative technology to simplify sales tax management for its clients.
